excerpt.zh:
许多具有显著或非常规基因变异的个体已被社会排斥。被迫转入地下的这些变种人已经形成了他们自己的聚居地。

那些冒险进入这些区域的人很少能够回来。
excerpt.en:
Many individuals with prominent or unconventional genetic mutations have been ostracized from society. Forced underground, these mutants have formed their own enclaves.

Those who venture into these areas seldom return.
